transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I’ve been having thoughts like... maybe it would be better if I didn’t wake up. And sometimes I feel like dying would be a fair punishment for what I’ve done to my family and the people I work with.
Have you had any specific plans or done anything to prepare for ending your life?

I haven’t really made a plan or set anything up. It’s more that I keep thinking it would be better if I just didn’t wake up... and sometimes I feel like dying would be what I deserve, like a punishment for what I’ve done to my family and my crew.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?
Yes. It’s been pretty much most days for a long time now... about a year and two months, I think. It started a few months after my husband got injured, and it just hasn’t really let up.
Have you noticed a decrease in interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy, nearly every day, over the past year?

Yes. I used to paint and cook big meals, and I’d run before jobs. I was also going to theater rehearsals. Now all of that just feels like chores from somebody else’s life. I don’t really care if I miss any of it anymore.
Have you noticed yourself moving more slowly than usual, or have you felt restless and unable to sit still for most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah… more restless, I think. At work I’ll catch myself pacing the same hallway with my trowel in my hand, checking the grout lines again and again. Then sometimes I just freeze in a doorway because it feels like if I move, something bad is going to happen.
Have you had times when you felt excessively guilty or believed that you were worthless or undeserving?

Yes. I feel guilty almost all the time. I keep thinking I’m the reason my husband got worse, and that I caused problems for the crew and messed up clients’ homes somehow. It feels like everything I touch gets ruined… like I poisoned it, and I deserve whatever happens to me.
Have you felt a lack of energy or felt fatigued most of the time, nearly every day?

Yes. Most days I’m just wiped out. Like, I’ll carry one box of tile or answer a couple client messages, and my body feels like wet cement. My head gets so tired too—I can’t even make simple decisions sometimes.
Have you had trouble sleeping through the night or falling asleep, nearly every day?
I’m not really sure. I mean, some nights are rough, but I haven’t been keeping track of it like that. I can’t say it’s nearly every night.
Did your feelings of depression start during your pregnancy or within a few weeks after giving birth?
I’m not sure. I don’t really connect it to pregnancy or right after giving birth. I can’t say it started then.
Have you had episodes of depression like this before, or is this the first time you've felt this way?

I don’t really know. I’ve had low periods before, but I’m not sure if they were like this or if they’d count as the same kind of episode. This feels pretty bad, but I can’t clearly say if it’s the first time or not.
Can you think of a time before this current period of depression where you felt down most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks, and lost interest in things you normally enjoyed?

I’m not really sure. I’ve had times where I was pretty down for a while, but I don’t know if it was most of the day, every day, for two weeks like that. And I can’t clearly remember if I stopped enjoying things in that way before this.
Can you recall if there was ever a time before this current period when you had a two-week period where you felt down most of the day nearly every day and lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

I still can’t really recall one clearly. I know I’ve had times before where I felt low, but I can’t say for sure it was for two weeks straight and that I lost interest in things like that. It’s kind of blurry when I try to think back.
Can you think back and confirm if there was ever a time before this current period where you felt down most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?
No, I can’t really confirm that. I’ve felt down at different times before, but I don’t remember clearly enough to say it was most of the day, nearly every day, for two weeks.

Can you recall if there was ever a time before this current period—by at least a couple of months—when you had a major low period that lasted for a while, and then cleared up enough that you felt back to normal for a time before this current episode started?

I don’t really remember a clear time like that. I’ve had rough stretches before, but I can’t say there was one that lasted a while, then fully cleared up where I felt normal again for a couple months before this started. It’s hard for me to pin that down.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt unusually high, extremely irritable, or so energetic that others noticed something was different?

I don’t think so. I can’t recall a stretch like that lasting two weeks where I felt unusually high or had that much energy that people noticed. I do get irritable sometimes, but not like a clear period like you’re describing.
